_comment: The canonical query chips for the first screen. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH and it is
read by two consumers: the SPA renders it, and tests/test_chips.py validates every id, direction
and expectation against the pinned artifact. That pairing is the point — the standing rule adopted
2026-08-02 is that a corpus change must fail the build rather than a demo.
Chip selection is phase-5 IMPLEMENTATION 4.3, decided by sjtroxel 2026-08-24. Five chips: four
answer outright, the fifth is a paired chip that refuses and then answers. Do not add a sixth
without re-reading 4.3 — the count landed at the floor of SPEC.md 2.1's 5-7 range as a side effect
of merging the Kate Bush pair, and the open slot is discussed there.
